about_the_game:
The steam civilization was destroyed by a huge disaster, and the surviving humans entered the former forbidden area with their broken machines. Manipulate a massive steam powered land ark, construct a mobile city, and explore this mysterious and dangerous world.

Ark Legion is a game that combines strategy RTS and survival building gameplay. If you have any questions, you can join QQ group 261293882 and we will do our best to answer them for you.

Build a huge ark

The cabin functions inside the ark can be freely modified. Different devices can be placed in the same cabin. Establishing an efficient production line or creating a comfortable living cabin, everything depends on your planning.

Explore the vast world

The world map consists of over 30000 hexagonal grid plots. The different terrains, organisms, resources, objects, relics, and other contents in the plot constitute this rich and colorful world. Hunting creatures, gathering resources, exploring ruins, and picking up items can all make your ark stronger.

Trade between cities

The dangerous trade routes that shuttle between cities established by different factions can bring rich rewards.

The Battle of Iron and Fire

Thieves' plundering and trade alliances' counterattacks can both trigger battles. There were both artillery battles between the ark and intense hand to hand combat inside the cabin.

short_description: A 2D adventure game that integrates gameplay such as exploration, trade, construction, and strategic battles. Drive a massive ark to explore the open world, equip your ark with different cabins and accessories, and build your own mobile fortress.
